verdict.rationale: Intel's oneAPI toolchain backs this as a first-class target. It provides oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations aimed specifically at Core Ultra series 2, VTune Profiler analysis features for these client chips, the DPC++ toolchain, and broad framework support (OpenVINO, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX RT). Phoronix's Linux review shows compile workloads running, though it hit memory-speed-related segfaults, and the Windows launch needed OS and firmware fixes for crashes and performance consistency. missing for 10: explicit evidence of mainstream compiler (GCC/LLVM/MSVC) tuning for Arrow Lake, a published architecture optimization manual, independent corroboration of tier-one OS/tooling support beyond the rocky Windows launch.
